theme_central: Arrogance (kibr/istikbar) as the central spiritual disease — that of Iblis, of Pharaoh, of the proud leaders of every people who reject their prophet.
sources_note: Structure cross-checked on two sources (grokipedia/azlyrahman in English, islamreligion.com + nabulsi.com in French), with confirmed key verses (Adam/Iblis 11-27, Nuh 59-64, Hud 65-72, Salih 73-79, Lot 80-84, Shu'ayb 85-92, Musa 103-171, covenant 172-174).

branches.title: Opening
branches.resume: The Book sent to warn; the fate of destroyed cities, the weighing of deeds.

children.t: The Book to warn, follow only this revelation
Fate of the destroyed cities, the weighing of deeds

branches.title: Adam, Iblis, the fall — the source of "Al-A'raf"
branches.resume: Creation of Adam, Iblis's refusal, the expulsion from Paradise, then the scene of Judgment where "the people of al-A'raf" appear, between Paradise and Hell.

children.t: Creation of Adam, Iblis's refusal to bow, his oath to tempt
Adam and Hawwa in Paradise, the forbidden fruit, the expulsion
Denouncing invented prohibitions, Allah's true prohibitions
The scene of Judgment: the people of the Fire, of Paradise, and the people of al-A'raf in between
Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, signs in rain and vegetation

branches.title: The rejected prophets
branches.resume: Nuh, Hud, Salih, Lot, Shu'ayb: the same pattern repeated, a people rejecting its prophet out of pride.

children.t: Nuh and the flood
Hud and the people of 'Ad
Salih, the people of Thamud and the she-camel
Lot and his people
Shu'ayb and the people of Madyan, fraud in trade
General lesson: why these cities did not believe despite the trials

branches.title: Musa and Pharaoh
branches.resume: The longest narrative development in the surah: the sorcerers' challenge, the plagues of Egypt, the golden calf, the Tablets of the Law.

children.t: Musa facing Pharaoh, the sorcerers' challenge
The plagues of Egypt, the crossing of the sea
The Tablets of the Law, the golden calf, Musa's anger
Announcement of Prophet Muhammad awaited in the Torah and the Gospel
The 12 tribes, the people who transgressed the Sabbath

branches.title: The primordial covenant
branches.resume: "Am I not your Lord?" — the innate testimony of every soul, and the parable of those who reject it.

children.t: The primordial covenant (alastu bi-rabbikum)
Parable of the one who rejects the signs, compared to a panting dog

branches.title: The most beautiful names, the Hour
branches.resume: Those whose hearts do not understand, the most beautiful names of Allah, the inability of idols to help even themselves.

children.t: Those created for Hell, the most beautiful names of Allah (al-asma al-husna)
Respite granted to the disbelievers, reflecting on the dominion of the heavens
Question about the Hour, the inability of idols to help even themselves

branches.title: Final instructions
branches.resume: Forgiveness, keeping away from the ignorant, refuge against Satan, final prostration.

children.t: Forgiving, keeping away from the ignorant, seeking refuge against Satan's suggestions
Listening to the Qur'an in silence, the verse of prostration (sajda)
